apps.name: ESP Remote Control
apps.subtitle: Keyboard and trackpad over Bluetooth
apps.localizedDescription: Use your iPhone as a keyboard and trackpad through an ESP32-S3 BLE-to-USB HID bridge, or try experimental direct Bluetooth HID without an adapter. Includes English and Ukrainian input, Shortcuts for text and URLs, a full-screen keyboard, clipboard typing, and pairing controls. ESP remains the initial default. Direct input has been user-tested on macOS; Linux and Windows testing is pending.

permissions.usageDescription: Connects to the ESP32-S3 bridge or directly to a computer as a Bluetooth keyboard and mouse.

versions.localizedDescription: Tap the Bluetooth computer name/status to choose a saved computer directly from the main or compact keyboard strip. A checkmark identifies the connected computer; a clock marks the selected computer awaiting input. The popup also links to pairing a new computer. This release includes the separately merged Share Extension handoff to the main app, which uses its selected output and computer; physical iPhone handoff testing is still needed. Keeps the startup crash fix and small version/build stamp.

Fixes the startup crash caused by CoreBluetooth restoring a saved HID descriptor. HID services are now created fresh on launch while saved computer names, selection, and system pairing are preserved. Adds a small version/build stamp in the main connection header without moving controls or intercepting touches; settings and connection logs also include the build number. The shared Bluetooth transport fix also applies to Share Extension. After iOS terminates the process, open the app to start HID again.

Bluetooth now shows the active computer and remembers multiple hosts. Select a saved computer, give it a local name, or forget it from the menu. Existing host selection migrates automatically. Improves reconnect advertising and distinguishes outgoing BLE disconnects from active HID subscriptions. Connection logs include host IDs and detailed errors. Forgetting removes app selection and auto-reconnect; system Bluetooth pairing is managed separately. Share Extension retains its own host selection.

Restores short taps on UA/EN and the orientation lock. Short UA/EN switches both the screen and host layout; holding changes only the screen. Tap the lock to lock/unlock the current orientation, or hold to force landscape. Short, long, repeated and cancelled presses are now checked in iPhone Simulator UI tests.

Hold UA/EN on the full-screen keyboard to change only the on-screen layout, without sending the host shortcut. Tap the orientation lock to lock the current orientation or unlock it; hold to force landscape. Long presses use a 0.5-second hold.

Experimental direct Bluetooth keyboard and mouse without an ESP adapter. Switch ESP / Bluetooth in the connection strip, initiate pairing from the computer or iPhone, and share connection diagnostics. ESP remains the initial default. Physical-device validation is pending.
Multilingual native and full-screen keyboard, clipboard input, improved trackpad, and reliable BLE reconnect.
